cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：意思是；意味着
cards.example_en: A red flag on the beach can mean danger.
cards.example_zh: 海滩上的红旗可能意味着有危险。

cards.example_en: We meet our teacher at the museum entrance.
cards.example_zh: 我们在博物馆入口遇见老师。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：想念；错过
cards.example_en: I still miss my primary school friends on weekends.
cards.example_zh: 到了周末，我仍然想念小学的朋友。

cards.example_en: Plants on the classroom windowsill need water and sunlight.
cards.example_zh: 教室窗台上的植物需要水和阳光。

cards.example_en: In science class we observe how ice melts in a bowl.
cards.example_zh: 科学课上，我们观察冰块在碗里怎样融化。

cards.example_en: We will organise a school fair next month.
cards.example_zh: 我们下个月将组织一场校园集市。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：在……上方；结束
cards.example_en: A plane flew over our school.
cards.example_zh: 一架飞机飞过我们学校上空。

cards.example_en: Their partnership in the bakery has lasted ten years.
cards.example_zh: 他们在这家面包店的合伙已经持续了十年。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：经过；通过
cards.example_en: We pass the bakery every day on the way home.
cards.example_zh: 我们每天回家路上都会经过那家面包店。

cards.example_en: She helped me pick a clean shirt for the school photo.
cards.example_zh: 她帮我为学校拍照挑了一件干净衬衫。

cards.example_en: Our plan is to visit the zoo on Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 我们的计划是星期天去动物园。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：玩；演奏
cards.example_en: They play basketball on the outdoor court after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 他们午饭后在室外球场打篮球。

cards.example_en: Please prepare your books before class.
cards.example_zh: 上课前请准备好你的书。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：展示；呈现
cards.example_en: Each group will present its survey results on Monday.
cards.example_zh: 每个小组将在星期一展示调查结果。
